This declaration claims no signature. BILL-1 patient billing release 1 with pharmacy point-of-care stock (Release D, the department sprint the owner approved on 25 November 2026; hid-system#336), built at the recommended option of each open question (BILL-7 to BILL-17), not yet answered by the owner, and switched off at real facilities (COMMERCIAL_BILLING_ENABLED, COMMERCIAL_PAY_BEFORE_ENABLED, COMMERCIAL_ONLINE_PAYMENT_ENABLED). Releases after 0001-0153 (backend release E, live since 25 November 2026 17:04 UTC); production's pending set is then exactly the six migrations below. runtime-grants.sql is release E's signed file (49b378f5...) plus the BILL-1 block, unchanged otherwise. The independent review's confirmed findings are fixed in 0164-0167 (prescription-only medicines on counter bills, the till-day close race, lines after a hand-over, free sales, dispensing reversals) and pharmacy-api (the pay-before refusal of a dispensing that accepted the item first). The independent re-check's problems are fixed in 0164 and 0167: a reversed medicine's line always comes off the bill, part paid or not, with what was collected beyond the bill kept as refund_due_kobo (the patient's money first) and cover_over_kobo; and an anonymous lab bill is a walk-in lab bill instead of a 23514 failure. Rahman's final check of 6b253568 (#336, 25 November 2026, 20:53 and 21:46 UTC) and the coordinator's decisions (#258, 21:20 UTC) are addressed at the sha256s below: commercial.outstanding uses no temporary table (a runtime could make one first, with a trigger that then ran as the schema owner); 0162's and 0167's preconditions accept other wave 1 lanes' role codes and triggers (the 0001-0151 codes and Release C's triggers required as a subset, Billing's own 58 role rows pinned); a dispensing reversal cancels only the line that bills that dispensing (commercial.bill_lines.dispensing_id, set by the first dispensing), and a refill (ORD-12's fill_number above 1) of a billed work item is refused REFILL_BILLING_NOT_AVAILABLE until refills are billed; bill and receipt numbers keep every digit past 999999; the post-checks pin each table's policy and exact triggers, 0167's triggers' column, arguments and WHEN, and 0162's rewritten role functions' SECURITY DEFINER, search_path and grants; a till day's opening and counted cash may be up to 100,000,000,000 kobo (Rahman's suggested bound, for the owner to confirm); money over a bill is listed (status money_over), summed (bill_summary's moneyOver) and marked in the HMO receivables (overBill); an index serves the work list's bill badge; pay-before reads the bill FOR SHARE; 0164 also locks the two 0163 tables its foreign keys use; a nameless walk-in reads "Walk-in" everywhere. Left for the owner: Rahman's item 7 (a cashier can turn a Health ID into a name through bill_attach_patient) and item 8 (a reversal on a bill with other lines can show an HMO cover or a waiver as refund due), BILL-17 (the two QA mailboxes), and the cash bound.

Database suites on that build, each run by the cluster superuser: 125 of 127 pass, among them patient-billing (245 cases); schema and records-processing-draft fail with the same errors when live 0cfddcc9's own suites run on the live schema, and my-orders' 10-second page case passes and fails alike on both on this loaded machine. The escalation was reproduced on the previous 0164 (6b253568) as a login role in hid_ehr_api_runtime with a billing officer's session: a pg_temp.commercial_outstanding made first, with a BEFORE TRUNCATE trigger, ran as the migrator, granted SELECT on identity.patients, and the runtime read another facility's patients; at these files the same steps fire nothing and the read is refused. The new list gives the same answers and audit rows as the previous one on 20 age and page pairs (192 items). The new suite cases fail on the previous 0164 and 0167 (the runtime's own temporary table fires twice and gains SELECT; reversing a second dispensing cancels the first one's line). patient-billing also passes with the EHR runtime's trapping temporary views made first for all 272 relation names of the application schemas, so no function resolves a name through pg_temp. Every function 0163-0167 makes has search_path pg_catalog, pg_temp (the post-checks require it), and 0162's rewritten role functions keep Release C's, each ending in pg_temp; no definer uses a temporary table, and the only dynamic SQL in a function body is two constant, schema-qualified queries with bound values (0163). An event trigger that weakens the bills policy, or disables payments.no_delete or till_days.closed_day_guard, during the apply makes 0164's or 0165's post-check refuse.
